text:
Type: three-arm black metal candlestick
Use: holding three taper candles on a dining table, a sideboard or a mantel; dining room, living room
Style: minimalist, Scandinavian, modern
Materials: matte black painted metal
Colors: matte black
Shape: central tube with two curved arms that rise into three tall cylindrical cups, wide shallow round tray base, sculptural and graphic, medium visual weight
Feel: graphic, sculptural, calm, modern
Goes with: white tapers, light wood tables, linen, white walls; Scandinavian, minimalist or modern dining rooms

product.name: ENIGHET
product.description: Elegant candlestick that both give an atmospheric light and is beautiful in its own right.
